summary.name: mpv
summary.one_liner: mpv is a free, open source, cross-platform command-line media player with broad format support, scripting, and high-quality video output.
use_cases: play video files from the terminal
play a wide range of audio and video formats
watch HDR or high-quality video with advanced scaling
embed a media player in another application
summary.what_it_does: mpv is a command-line media player that supports many media file formats, audio and video codecs, and subtitle types. Its scripting capabilities let users extend playback behavior, and a community wiki hosts a selection of user scripts. It provides no full GUI, only a small on-screen controller for basic control. Video output uses OpenGL, Vulkan, or D3D11 and offers features such as high-quality scaling, color management, frame timing, interpolation, and HDR. It can use hardware decoding APIs, enabled at runtime, and exposes a C API so it can be used as a library.
notable: Command-line player with minimal GUI and a small on-screen controller
Embeddable via a C API for use as a library
Scripting support with a large selection of user scripts on the wiki
High-quality video output with scaling, color management, interpolation and HDR
caveats: Provides no real GUI, so it is oriented toward command-line use
Page does not state the specific platforms by name beyond cross-platform
